card.name: Size units before wide or across
card.fires_on: Unit words like ft, inch, feet or cubits right after a number in a physical size description, where 'wide', 'across' or 'broad' comes next.

modes.label: Width measures
modes.description: A length unit after a number, just before 'wide', 'broad' or 'across' in descriptions of plants or buildings.
